detailed_prompt: Inside a circular glass-dome observatory at dawn, rain streaks the curved glass above a ring of brass consoles with amber instrument lights. Kael, a man in his thirties with short dark hair, light stubble and a charcoal field jacket. The camera tilts down from the dome ribs and pushes in behind his shoulder. 0.0–1.4s, seen in profile: Kael stands at the rain-streaked glass, listening, weight on his back foot. 1.4–2.8s, seen from behind: he turns from the glass to the console, shoulders squaring. 2.8–4.3s, seen from behind: his left hand finds the large brass dial and turns it; far beyond the glass a beacon light blinks on. 4.3–4.8s, seen from behind: he jerks his hand off the dial and recoils, his head snapping back, both arms flying up in front of his chest, his upper body rocking back half a step. 4.8–6.0s, seen from behind: he holds the recoil, arms raised, head thrown back toward the light, shoulders locked. One person only. No text.
